purpose: Validate SW3 bridge from market trend directions into low-risk candidate universe without changing formal screening.
interpretation: The SW3 bridge is mechanically compatible. On this diagnostic subset, the currently active trend directions produced only two structurally relevant low-risk candidates, and both were rejected by the existing company-level Gate. Therefore a valid bridge can legitimately result in no current low-risk stock opportunity rather than forcing exposure to hot sectors.
limitations: This is a targeted bridge diagnostic, not a complete rerun of the full market-trend ranking across every industry and concept.
The provisional T1/T2 and market-state labels were established only for the three tested directions and must not be treated as the formal trend ranking output.
Do not promote the handoff to a hard formal low-risk entry filter until a complete trend-ranking run writes a VALID market_trend_handoff.json and additional shadow runs confirm behavior.
